title: Subscription, limits & billing
public_subtitle: Three clear plans for time tracking, facility management, and enterprise portfolios. Try free for one month.
subtitle: After your free month, choose a plan. Limits apply per organisation for units, documents, photos and users.
plans_intro: WinProx Time is the compact plan for small organisations. WinProx Facility scales to 100 locations and units. WinProx Corporate adds ESG, API and unlimited scale.
admin_required: Only an administrator can choose a subscription. Contact your organisation's administrator.

facility_not_included: Issues, tasks and calendar require WinProx Facility or Corporate. Upgrade your plan to unlock facility workflows.
status_legacy: Your organisation does not use trial tracking yet (legacy account). All features remain available.
status_grace: Subscription :plan ended on :ended. Grace period until :grace_end — :days days of full access left. Renew in time to avoid interruption.
status_expired: Your trial has ended. Choose a plan below to continue.
pricing_intro: WinProx includes a one-month free trial with facility and time features. After that, choose the plan that matches your organisation.
status_module_esg: ESG module active on your account.
status_module_time: Time module active on your account.

time.name: WinProx Time
time.scale: Up to 10 units/locations/documents/photos for your organisation.
time.users: Includes 1 administrator and 1 staff member. Unlimited workers via CSV import.
time.description: Unlimited QR issues and tasks within your locations and units.
features: Time module: clock in/out, breaks, shifts and QR Clock Points.

facility.name: WinProx Facility
facility.scale: Up to 100 units/locations/documents/photos for your organisation.
facility.users: Includes 1 administrator and up to 4 staff members. Unlimited workers via CSV import.
facility.description: Full facility workflows at larger scale. WinProx Time included. CSV bulk import for units and workers.
features: Unlimited QR issues and tasks within your locations and units.
